applicability: any checkout with a README*, SECURITY*, CHANGELOG*/HISTORY*/NEWS, CONTRIBUTING*, man page or document under a doc/design/spec-like path outside the exclusion globs; otherwise SKIPPED not-applicable-no-matching-inputs

optional: B16 record of the pinned audit-doc-convert image (pdftotext, pandoc); needed only when a PDF or DOCX is in the document universe

files_logged.description: Former cap on applicable input files; now logged.

records_logged.description: Former cap on extracted records; now logged.

file_max_bytes.description: Bytes read per text, HTML or man-page document; larger ones are oversized-input gaps.

binary_document_max_bytes.description: Largest PDF or DOCX converted (and the DOCX unpacked-size bound); larger ones are oversized-input gaps.

pdf_min_text_chars_per_page.description: Non-whitespace characters per page below which a PDF is an image-only-or-scanned-pdf gap (no OCR).

converted_text_max_bytes.description: Converted text kept per document (the evidence index text limit); the rest is a converted-text-truncated gap.

converted_line_max_chars.description: Longer converted lines are split; each piece keeps its line's provenance.

image_id.description: Pinned image holding pdftotext (poppler-utils) and pandoc for PDF/DOCX conversion.

container_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for one conversion container (document conversion).
container_timeout_seconds.scale: Converted text per PDF/DOCX document grows with page count; one container per document.

container_memory_bytes.description: Memory limit for one conversion container (document conversion).
container_memory_bytes.scale: Converted text per PDF/DOCX document grows with page count; one container per document.

container_cpu_millis.scale: Converted text per PDF/DOCX document grows with page count; one container per document.

container_pids.scale: Converted text per PDF/DOCX document grows with page count; one container per document.

container_tmpfs_bytes.scale: Converted text per PDF/DOCX document grows with page count; one container per document.

container_stdout_limit_bytes.description: Captured stdout; beyond this the log is truncated (document conversion).
container_stdout_limit_bytes.scale: Converted text per PDF/DOCX document grows with page count; one container per document.

container_stderr_limit_bytes.description: Captured stderr; beyond this the log is truncated (document conversion).
container_stderr_limit_bytes.scale: Converted text per PDF/DOCX document grows with page count; one container per document.
